sources.entry: NandGame: build a computer from scratch.

summary.title: NandGame
summary.one_liner: Learn how a computer is built from the ground up by solving puzzles that start with a NAND gate built from wires and relays and progress to a programmable computer.
takeaways: Build a NAND component from relays and wires, matching a given truth table.
Each completed level's component becomes a building block for the next level.
No prior knowledge of computer architecture or software is required; only addition and subtraction math.
The progression runs from simple logic components to a programmable computer.
summary.summary: NandGame is an interactive educational puzzle game in which you build a computer starting from basic components. Each level asks you to wire up relays and inputs so a component matches a specified truth table, beginning with a NAND gate. Components you finish become building blocks for later levels. The page states that it needs no prior architecture or software knowledge and only addition and subtraction math, though some tasks can be slow to solve.
